title: REQ · checkTrackedFiles and parseGitLsFiles report tracked dependency and vitest-cache paths
summary: Helper file exposes parseGitLsFiles and checkTrackedFiles over a null-separated git ls-files -z listing.
description: Context: helper file only filters node_modules segments from a string array. Desired behavior: parseGitLsFiles splits null-separated output and drops empty entries; checkTrackedFiles(run) runs git ls-files -z and returns every path under node_modules or in the vitest cache. Expected result: one export of each name, no duplicates. Why: a single testable detection point for the guard.
acceptance_criteria: Given 'a\0b\0' , When parseGitLsFiles runs, Then it returns ['a','b'] with no empty entry.
Given a runner returning 'src/a.ts\0node_modules/x.js\0', When checkTrackedFiles runs, Then it returns ['node_modules/x.js'] and the runner was called with ['ls-files','-z'].
Given a path 'game/frontend/node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json', When checkTrackedFiles runs, Then it is reported.
Given the helper file, When parsed, Then each helper name is exported exactly once.

preserve: trackedNodeModulesPaths semantics (segment match, look-alike names not matched)

technical_constraints: Vitest cache = path containing the segments .vite/vitest
